project_name: FLORAai - Indian Spice Plant Health & Botanical AI Platform
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Botanical Precision + Warm Spice Palette)

language_and_tech.styling: Tailwind CSS + Custom CSS Variables + Lucide Icons + Framer Motion + Recharts + Sonner Toasts
language_and_tech.note: DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx) syntax or interfaces in code creation. Use React standard JS / JSX.

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond (Serif, Organic & Authoritative)
typography.body_font: Manrope / Plus Jakarta Sans (Clean, Legible Humanist Sans)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro (For AI Scan Telemetry, Confidence % & Scientific Botanical Names)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-50 leading-tight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-100
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-serif font-medium text-emerald-850 dark:text-emerald-200
hierarchy.h4: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans font-semibold text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-700/70 dark:text-emerald-400/70

rules.tinted_grey: Never use pure #000000 or #ffffff without warm olive/emerald tinting.
rules.gradient_limit: Max 15% subtle linear background gradients. Never dark full-screen saturated blue/purple gradients.
rules.cta_contrast: Primary buttons use Deep Forest Emerald (#1c3a13) with Lime Pulse (#d3fa99) or Crisp White text, or Gold Terracotta CTA buttons.
rules.hover_contrast: Interactive items MUST explicitly define hover text and background colors simultaneously (e.g. hover:bg-emerald-800 hover:text-white).

spacing_and_layout.containers: Containers must have internal padding (p-6, p-8 or p-12) to prevent content edge collisions.
spacing_and_layout.section_padding: py-16 sm:py-24 for major marketing / auth hero sections; py-8 for dashboard grids.
spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Bento Grid protocol with direct wrapper children. Use asymmetric spans (e.g. col-span-8 and col-span-4) for marketing/dashboard showcase.
spacing_and_layout.border_radii: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements, rounded-full for pills/badges.

navigation_and_header.header_style: Sticky, backdrop-blur-xl bg-emerald-950/85 dark:bg-emerald-950/90 light:bg-emerald-50/85 text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-50 border-b border-emerald-800/20 z-50
navigation_and_header.desktop_nav: Must render visible links: Home, Explore Spices, Scan AI, History, Pricing, About, Login/Sign Up (or Profile avatar dropdown if logged in).
navigation_and_header.mobile_nav: Sheet / Drawer sidebar triggered by hamburger button.
navigation_and_header.user_menu: Avatar with user initials / custom profile photo, dropdown menu containing Profile, Settings, History, Admin (if role === 'admin'), and Sign Out.

auth_and_pages_guide.auth_layout: Split-screen or glassmorphic centered card with botanical plant background art and live spice plant facts.

routes./: Public marketing homepage with botanical hero banner, Indian spice plant diagnostic gallery, live preview scanner demo, test pricing, and call-to-action.
routes./login: Botanical themed login form with email, password, remember me, forgot password link, social login option, and link to sign up.
routes./signup: Botanical themed sign-up with Full Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password, Gardening Experience level (Beginner/Home Garden/Spice Plantation Owner), and primary spice interest selection.
routes./forgot-password: Email recovery request form with instant feedback state and return to login link.
routes./reset-password: Secure new password input form with strength meter and confirmation.
routes./verify-email: OTP / 6-digit code verification or email link confirmation simulation screen with resend timer.
routes./dashboard: Flora Dashboard with plant image capture/upload dropzone, camera toggle, Indian spice selector (Curry Leaf, Cardamom, Turmeric, Black Pepper, Clove, Cinnamon), health score gauge, recent scan quick view, and recommendation panel.
routes./history: Filterable archive of all past plant health diagnostic reports, search by plant name or disease state (Healthy, Blight, Leaf Spot, Root Rot, Deficiency), date picker, and export report option.
routes./profile: User profile manager: Personal info, avatar picker, bio, gardening experience level, saved plant bookmarks, and security tab.
routes./settings: Preferences & notification settings: Scan detail level, AI confidence threshold, dark/light theme toggle, email digest preferences, and API key / privacy settings.
routes./admin: Admin Control Center: System health, total users, total plant scans, regional outbreak map/chart (e.g. Kerala Cardamom Blight alert), user role management (User/Admin promotion), and scan logs table.

botanical_spice_plants_focus.name: Curry Leaf Plant (Murraya koenigii)
botanical_spice_plants_focus.remedies: Neem oil spray, copper fungicide, balance soil pH to 6.0-7.0.

botanical_spice_plants_focus.name: Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum)
botanical_spice_plants_focus.remedies: Improve shade drainage, destroy affected clumps, apply organic bio-agents (Trichoderma).

botanical_spice_plants_focus.name: Turmeric (Curcuma longa)
botanical_spice_plants_focus.remedies: Crop rotation, seed rhizome treatment with Trichoderma viride, organic potash.

botanical_spice_plants_focus.name: Black Pepper (Piper nigrum)
botanical_spice_plants_focus.remedies: Bordeaux mixture 1% application, soil drenching, pruning shaded canopy.

botanical_spice_plants_focus.name: Cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum)
botanical_spice_plants_focus.remedies: Prune infected shoots, organic sulfur spray, maintain organic compost mulching.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, links, forms, tabs, dropdowns, and status badges MUST carry a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='plant-upload-input', data-testid='admin-users-table').
testing_and_accessibility.form_accessibility: Ensure all inputs have explicit labels (<label htmlFor='...'>) and aria-describedby for error states.
testing_and_accessibility.toast_notifications: Use Sonner component imported from src/components/ui/sonner for interactive feedback (toast.success, toast.error).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete responsive design supporting mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.

Implement real client-side state / mock API handlers for full authentication lifecycle (Sign Up, Login, Forgot Password, Reset Password, Verify Email, Profile Updates, Settings persist, Scan Upload, Scan History filtering, Admin operations).
Preserve role-based navigation guard (e.g. standard users see their dashboard/history; admins see administrative user management and aggregate stats).
In corporate/botanical views, maintain rich visual polish using layered cards, subtle borders, high-contrast accessible typography, and smooth state transitions.
Always test inputs and buttons with data-testid attributes for reliable end-to-end verification.
